info.name: Mixcloud - Phosphor Vector | Retro Hacker Green
info.description: A retro terminal-inspired skin for Mixcloud, built on the working Tropical Neon Afterhours V16 theme. Electric phosphor-green links, outlines and waveform accents glow against dark forest-black, while translucent cards and navigation reveal a monochrome green waterfront skyline. A native Consolas/Lucida Console/Courier New font stack brings classic command-line typography throughout the interface. The original V16 artist-strip repair, player waveform, layout and selector coverage remain intact.
